name: Antra
tagline: Desktop music library builder that turns streaming links into a fully tagged local library
description: Antra is a desktop music library builder that converts Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Amazon Music, Tidal, Qobuz, and Deezer links into a fully tagged local library in FLAC, ALAC, AAC, or MP3. It is built for people who want to own their music, with support for lossless formats and integration with self-hosted servers like Jellyfin and Navidrome. The project is Python-based with a desktop interface.
highlights: Converts links from 7+ streaming services into a local library
Lossless FLAC/ALAC support with AAC/MP3 options
Jellyfin and Navidrome friendly for self-hosted setups
1.9k stars with an engaged music-ownership community
curatorNote: Own-your-music is a growing movement, and Antra is the friendliest open on-ramp: paste a playlist link, get a tagged local library. Lossless-first design seals it.
